_comment: An address is recorded here ONLY after gen_getContractSchema confirms it is live. An empty address means not deployed, and the frontend fails closed on it.

studio_next.verified_by: gen_getContractSchema returned 15 methods including expire_case; get_config returned the expected constants (2/2/1 GEN bonds, 21600s appeal, 259200s expiry, 200 bps, 42-char treasury); a non-party calling expire_case on funded OPEN case NON-000001 was refused on chain with 'not a party to this case' (tx 0xd96eb029130f0eb9d22fb4571c3d393b1babe8ee89f7ca6b1f046d0de9a9a66d, FINISHED_WITH_ERROR, case left OPEN); two real bonded cases were opened and adjudicated live (NON-000001 APPROVE, NON-000002 APPROVE)

superseded.reason: expire_case was unauthenticated: guarded only by case state and the clock, so any address could permanently end a funded case 72h after it opened. REVIEWING also had no expiry path. Both fixed in d246f1d and deployed to the address above.
CaseOpened declared 4 indexed event fields; ABI.EVENT_MAX_TOPICS is 4 INCLUDING the signature topic, so open_case aborted on chain with SystemError: 2: inval.
Pre-audit. Lacked the bounded expiry escape hatch, and did not bind the agreed envelope to the case id or its locked evidence urls.

studio_next.owner_note: Deployed from an ephemeral key generated in CI and funded via sim_fundAccount; that key was not retained. `owner` therefore has no live holder. This is contained: `treasury` and the core-grants scope `admin` are both constructor/parameter values set to 0xC6E6d3b2acCaECeCeB40Ad4bD3dF123DDCB4e537, so fee destination and constitution control are unaffected. `owner` only grants set_constitution on scopes the caller does not already admin.
